stakeout.shortDesc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled against a target that switched in this turn.
stakeout.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled against a target that switched in this turn.

stall.name: Stall
stall.shortDesc: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.
stall.desc: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.
stalwart.desc: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.
stamina.desc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.

stancechange.name: Stance Change
stancechange.shortDesc: If Aegislash, changes Forme to Blade before attacks and Shield before King's Shield.
stancechange.desc: If this Pokemon is an Aegislash, it changes to Blade Forme before using an attacking move, and changes to Shield Forme before using King's Shield.

static.name: Static
static.shortDesc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.
static.desc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.shortDesc: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
steadfast.desc: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.

steamengine.name: Steam Engine
steamengine.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by Fire/Water moves.
steamengine.desc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by a Fire- or Water-type move.

steelworker.name: Steelworker
steelworker.shortDesc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Steel-type attack.
steelworker.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Steel-type attack.

steelyspirit.name: Steely Spirit
steelyspirit.shortDesc: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.
steelyspirit.desc: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. This affects Doom Desire even if the user is not on the field.

stench.name: Stench
stench.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to flinch gain a 10% chance to flinch.
stench.desc: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

stickyhold.name: Sticky Hold
stickyhold.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack.
stickyhold.desc: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack, unless the attack knocks out this Pokemon. A Sticky Barb will be transferred to other Pokemon regardless of this Ability.

stormdrain.name: Storm Drain
stormdrain.shortDesc: This Pokemon draws Water moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Water immunity.
stormdrain.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Water-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Water-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.

strongjaw.name: Strong Jaw
strongjaw.shortDesc: This Pokemon's bite-based attacks have 1.5x power. Bug Bite is not boosted.
strongjaw.desc: This Pokemon's bite-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.5.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO.
sturdy.desc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokemon.

suctioncups.name: Suction Cups
suctioncups.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.
suctioncups.desc: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.

superluck.name: Super Luck
superluck.shortDesc: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.
superluck.desc: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.

supersweetsyrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweetsyrup.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.
supersweetsyrup.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.

supremeoverlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supremeoverlord.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.
supremeoverlord.desc: This Pokemon's moves have their power multiplied by 1+(X*0.1), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side when this Ability became active, and X cannot be greater than 5.

surgesurfer.name: Surge Surfer
surgesurfer.shortDesc: If Electric Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
surgesurfer.desc: If Electric Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Bug attacks.
swarm.desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack.

sweetveil.name: Sweet Veil
sweetveil.shortDesc: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep; those already asleep do not wake up.
sweetveil.desc: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep, but those already asleep do not wake up immediately. This Pokemon and its allies cannot use Rest successfully or become affected by Yawn, and those previously affected will not fall asleep.

swiftswim.name: Swift Swim
swiftswim.shortDesc: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
swiftswim.desc: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

swordofruin.name: Sword of Ruin
swordofruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75.
swordofruin.desc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.shortDesc: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately.
symbiosis.desc: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately. Does not activate if the ally's item was stolen or knocked off, or if the ally used an Eject Button or Eject Pack.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.shortDesc: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes this Pokemon, it also gets that status.
synchronize.desc: If another Pokemon burns, paralyzes, poisons, or badly poisons this Pokemon, that Pokemon receives the same non-volatile status condition.

tabletsofruin.name: Tablets of Ruin
tabletsofruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.
tabletsofruin.desc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.

tangledfeet.name: Tangled Feet
tangledfeet.shortDesc: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.
tangledfeet.desc: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.

tanglinghair.name: Tangling Hair
tanglinghair.shortDesc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.
tanglinghair.desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

technician.name: Technician
technician.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have 1.5x power, including Struggle.
technician.desc: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have their power multiplied by 1.5, including Struggle. This effect comes after a move's effect changes its own power.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.shortDesc: This Pokemon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.
telepathy.desc: This Pokemon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.

teraformzero.name: Teraform Zero
teraformzero.shortDesc: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.
teraformzero.desc: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.

terashell.name: Tera Shell
terashell.shortDesc: Terapagos: If full HP, attacks taken have 0.5x effectiveness unless naturally immune.
terashell.desc: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos at full HP, the effectiveness of attacks against it is changed to 0.5 unless this Pokemon is immune to the move. Multi-hit moves retain the same effectiveness throughout the attack.

terashift.name: Tera Shift
terashift.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.
terashift.desc: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.

teravolt.name: Teravolt
teravolt.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
teravolt.desc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

thermalexchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermalexchange.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 when damaged by Fire moves; can't be burned.
thermalexchange.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised 1 stage after it is damaged by a Fire-type move. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

thickfat.name: Thick Fat
thickfat.shortDesc: Fire-/Ice-type moves against this Pokemon deal damage with a halved offensive stat.
thickfat.desc: If a Pokemon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

tintedlens.name: Tinted Lens
tintedlens.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks that are not very effective on a target deal double damage.
tintedlens.desc: This Pokemon's attacks that are not very effective on a target deal double damage.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.
torrent.desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.

toughclaws.name: Tough Claws
toughclaws.shortDesc: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.
toughclaws.desc: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.

toxicboost.name: Toxic Boost
toxicboost.shortDesc: While this Pokemon is poisoned, its physical attacks have 1.5x power.
toxicboost.desc: While this Pokemon is poisoned, the power of its physical attacks is multiplied by 1.5.

toxicchain.name: Toxic Chain
toxicchain.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning.
toxicchain.desc: This Pokemon's attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning. This effect comes before a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

toxicdebris.name: Toxic Debris
toxicdebris.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.
toxicdebris.desc: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.

trace.name: Trace
trace.shortDesc: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.
trace.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies a random opposing Pokemon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.shortDesc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.
transistor.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.

triage.name: Triage
triage.shortDesc: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
triage.desc: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

truant.name: Truant
truant.shortDesc: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.
truant.desc: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.

turboblaze.name: Turboblaze
turboblaze.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
turboblaze.desc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.shortDesc: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's stat stages when taking or doing damage.
unaware.desc: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokemon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.shortDesc: Speed is doubled on held item loss; boost is lost if it switches, gets new item/Ability.
unburden.desc: If this Pokemon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.shortDesc: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries.
unnerve.desc: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.

unseenfist.name: Unseen Fist
unseenfist.shortDesc: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.
unseenfist.desc: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.

vesselofruin.name: Vessel of Ruin
vesselofruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.
vesselofruin.desc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.

victorystar.name: Victory Star
victorystar.shortDesc: This Pokemon and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.
victorystar.desc: This Pokemon and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.

vitalspirit.name: Vital Spirit
vitalspirit.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
vitalspirit.desc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

voltabsorb.name: Volt Absorb
voltabsorb.shortDesc: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.
voltabsorb.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.

wanderingspirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wanderingspirit.shortDesc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one.
wanderingspirit.desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokemon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

waterabsorb.name: Water Absorb
waterabsorb.shortDesc: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.
waterabsorb.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.

waterbubble.name: Water Bubble
waterbubble.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Water power is 2x; it can't be burned; Fire power against it is halved.
waterbubble.desc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled while using a Water-type attack. If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

watercompaction.name: Water Compaction
watercompaction.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.
watercompaction.desc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.

waterveil.name: Water Veil
waterveil.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
waterveil.desc: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

weakarmor.name: Weak Armor
weakarmor.shortDesc: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, Defense is lowered by 1, Speed is raised by 2.
weakarmor.desc: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages.

wellbakedbody.name: Well-Baked Body
wellbakedbody.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages if hit by a Fire move; Fire immunity.
wellbakedbody.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves and raises its Defense by 2 stages when hit by a Fire-type move.

whitesmoke.name: White Smoke
whitesmoke.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
whitesmoke.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

wimpout.name: Wimp Out
wimpout.shortDesc: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.
wimpout.desc: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.

windpower.name: Wind Power
windpower.shortDesc: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins.
windpower.desc: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from a wind move or when Tailwind begins on this Pokemon's side.

windrider.name: Wind Rider
windrider.shortDesc: Attack raised by 1 if hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins. Wind move immunity.
windrider.desc: This Pokemon is immune to wind moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a wind move or when Tailwind begins on this Pokemon's side.

wonderguard.name: Wonder Guard
wonderguard.shortDesc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
wonderguard.desc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.

wonderskin.name: Wonder Skin
wonderskin.shortDesc: Status moves with accuracy checks are 50% accurate when used on this Pokemon.
wonderskin.desc: Non-damaging moves that check accuracy have their accuracy changed to 50% when used against this Pokemon. This effect comes before other effects that modify accuracy.

zenmode.name: Zen Mode
zenmode.shortDesc: If Darmanitan, at end of turn changes Mode to Standard if > 1/2 max HP, else Zen.
zenmode.desc: If this Pokemon is a Darmanitan or Galarian Darmanitan, it changes to Zen Mode if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP at the end of a turn. If Darmanitan's HP is above 1/2 of its maximum HP at the end of a turn, it changes back to Standard Mode.

zerotohero.name: Zero to Hero
zerotohero.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
zerotohero.desc: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.

mountaineer.name: Mountaineer
mountaineer.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon avoids all Rock-type attacks and Stealth Rock.
mountaineer.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon avoids all Rock-type attacks and Stealth Rock.

rebound.name: Rebound
rebound.shortDesc: On switch-in, blocks certain status moves and bounces them back to the user.
rebound.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon blocks certain status moves and instead uses the move against the original user.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.shortDesc: When used, Gravity/Heal Block/Safeguard/Tailwind/Room effects last 2 more turns.
persistent.desc: The duration of Gravity, Heal Block, Magic Room, Safeguard, Tailwind, Trick Room, and Wonder Room is increased by 2 turns if the effect is started by this Pokemon.
